+// POST JSON to the API and answer its status and parsed body (null for a
+// 204 or an empty one).
+export async function postJson(
+  path: string,
+  body: unknown,
+): Promise<{ status: number; data: unknown }> {
+  const res = await fetch(path, {
+    method: 'POST',
+    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+    body: JSON.stringify(body),
+  })
+  let data: unknown = null
+  try {
+    data = await res.json()
+  } catch {
+    data = null
+  }
+  return { status: res.status, data }
+}

+import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
+import type { Me } from './types'
+
+export type AuthState = {
+  // user is who /api/me names, null when the session answers 401, and
+  // undefined while the first check is still running.
+  user: Me | null | undefined
+  refresh: () => Promise<Me | null | undefined>
+}
+
+// useAuth asks /api/me when the app mounts and shares the answer; a page
+// calls refresh after a sign up, a login or a logout.
+export function useAuth(): AuthState {
+  const [user, setUser] = useState<Me | null | undefined>(undefined)
+
+  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
+    try {
+      const res = await fetch('/api/me')
+      if (res.ok) setUser((await res.json()) as Me)
+      else setUser(null)
+    } catch {
+      setUser(null)
+    }
+    return user
+  }, [])
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    void refresh()
+  }, [refresh])
+
+  return { user, refresh }
+}

+afterEach(() => {
+  vi.unstubAllGlobals()
+})
+
+const me = { id: 7, email: 'ada@example.com' }
+
+// api answers the app's calls for a signed-in user with two links and daily
+// stats of thirty days; anything else is a 404.
+function api(overrides: Record<string, Reply> = {}) {
+  const days = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({
+    date: `2026-09-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
+    clicks: i === 29 ? 5 : i,
+  }))
+  return mockFetch((method, path) => {
+    const key = `${method} ${path}`
+    if (key in overrides) return overrides[key]
+    switch (key) {
+      case 'GET /api/me':
+        return { body: me }
+      case 'GET /healthz':
+        return { body: { status: 'ok' } }
+      case 'GET /api/links':
+        return {
+          body: [
+            { slug: 'alpha', targetURL: 'https://example.com/a', createdAt: '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z', totalClicks: 12 },
+            { slug: 'bravo', targetURL: 'https://example.com/b', createdAt: '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z', totalClicks: 0 },
+          ],
+        }
+      case 'POST /api/links':
+        return { status: 201, body: { slug: 'charlie', targetURL: 'https://example.com/c', createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z', totalClicks: 0 } }
+      case 'DELETE /api/links/alpha':
+        return { status: 204 }
+      case 'GET /api/links/alpha/stats':
+        return { body: { slug: 'alpha', totalClicks: 12, days } }
+      default:
+        return { status: 404, body: { error: 'not found' } }
+    }
+  })
+}
+
+describe('TestSignUpPage', () => {
+  test('renders signup form with email and password fields', async () => {
+    api({ 'GET /api/me': { status: 401, body: { error: 'unauthorized' } } })
+    renderAt('/signup')
+    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Sign up' })).toBeTruthy()
+    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Email')).toBeTruthy()
+    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Password')).toBeTruthy()
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign up' })).toBeTruthy()
+  })
+
+  test('signing up logs the visitor in and opens the links page', async () => {
+    const fetch = api({
+      'GET /api/me': { status: 401, body: { error: 'unauthorized' } },
+      'POST /api/signup': { status: 201, body: me },
